verdict.rationale: Pulumi automations are code in general-purpose languages, so they can be versioned in Git. Pulumi ships maintained version-control integrations with GitHub, GitLab, and Azure DevOps, and policy violations now appear in pull request comments and checks. For review, `pulumi preview` shows proposed changes without applying them. Missing for 10: any documented rollback or state-history restore, explicit versioning of Automation API or Neo-driven automations, and independent hands-on corroboration of the review/rollback workflow.
